messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into French, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Mais après être arrivé au pied d'une colline, là où se terminait cette vallée qui avait rempli mon cœur de peur,

After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | Ma | Coordinating conjunction introducing contrast (“but”) | **Mais** | “but” | OK | | poi | Adverb of time marking a later moment (“after”) | **après** | “after” | OK | | ch'i' | Contraction of *che io* – relative/complementizer + 1st‑person pronoun (“that I”) | — (subject omitted in French infinitive) | “that I” | **UNNECESSARY** | | fui | Auxiliary verb (past of *essere*) forming the perfect (“had been”) | **être** (as part of *être arrivé*) | “to be” | OK | | al | Preposition + definite article indicating location (“at the”) | **au** | “at the” | OK | | piè | Noun “foot” (base of a hill) | **pied** | “foot” | OK | | d'un | Preposition + indefinite article (“of a”) | **d'une** | “of a” | OK | | colle | Noun “hill” | **colline** | “hill” | OK | | giunto | Past participle “arrived / reached” | **arrivé** | “arrived” | OK | | là | Demonstrative adverb of place (“there”) | **là** | “there” | OK | | dove | Relative adverb of place (“where”) | **où** | “where” | OK | | terminava | Imperfect verb “ended” (ongoing) | **se terminait** | “was ending / ended” | OK | | quella | Demonstrative adjective “that” | **cette** | “that” | OK | | valle | Noun “valley” | **vallée** | “valley” | OK | | che | Relative pronoun referring to *valle* (“which”) | **qui** | “which / who” | OK | | m'avea | Pluperfect “had caused / had pierced” (mi aveva) | **avait** | “had” | OK | | di | Preposition linking noun to participle (“of / with”) | **de** | “of / with” | OK | | paura | Noun “fear” | **peur** | “fear” | OK | | il | Definite article “the” (here part of the possessive construction) | **mon** (possessive) | “my” | OK | | cor | Noun “heart” (metaphoric) | **cœur** | “heart” | OK | | compunto | Past participle “pierced / filled” | **rempli** | “filled / pierced” | OK |
